title: CLAUDE.md
text: build_obis_h3_duckdb(src, path_duckdb, ...) reads occurrences (data.frame parquet path(s)/glob(s) / s3:// URLs read via DuckDB httpfs), bins H3 res 7, writes three layers: idx_h3 — precomputed -taxa indicators, res 1–7 (fastest tile path). Carries hex_prune clustered (res, hex_prune, cell_id). idx_h3_taxon — precomputed per-taxon indicators coarse ranks (phylum/class/order — H3T_IDX_RANKS); finer ranks explode storage. Clustered (rank, taxon, res) (spatial prune — ’s already small). occ_h3 — species-level counts resolution tiers 3/5/7 (H3T_RES_TIERS), carrying hex_prune clustered (res, hex_prune, cell_id); used live taxon/year/aphiaid-filtered queries. Automatic per-tile spatial pruning (hex_prune). tile bbox fully determined z/x/y tile address, client never states . Zonemaps live stored columns, occ_h3/idx_h3 materialize coarse H3-parent key hex_prune = h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, LEAST(res, H3T_PRUNE_RES)) (res 3) clustered (res, hex_prune, cell_id). h3t server derives tile’s covering res-H3T_PRUNE_RES cells z/x/y (prune.covering_cells, dedicated -memory DuckDB h3 — canonical ids, version drift R build) rewrites query’s AST (prune.inject_prune) add hex_prune (...) scan table carrying column — pruning row groups tile 2D instead aggregating whole layer per tile. Injection skipped tiles coarser PRUNE_RES covering set exceeds MAX_COVER_CELLS; correctness always held outer centroid filter (wrap_tile_sql), pruning pure speed-. test-h3t-prune.R asserts result-preserving. Changing H3T_PRUNE_RES prune column means keeping build_obis_h3_duckdb(), config.PRUNE_RES, prune.covering_cells/inject_prune (server/h3t CalCOFI/api-h3t-py), test-h3t-prune.R agreement. Clients emit plain SELECTs — bbox_placeholder; earlier {{bbox}} token still stripped server-side (tiles.strip_bbox_placeholder) cached URLs. obis_h3t_sql(indicator, taxon, aphiaid, years, ...) composes read-SELECT (projecting exactly cell_id, value, n, {{res}} placeholder server substitutes per tile). routes fastest layer: filter → idx_h3; single coarse-rank value, years → idx_h3_taxon (hex_prune, never injected — already small); aphiaid filter → live occ_h3 filtered WoRMS subtree (see ); anything else finer/multi-value/year-ranged → live aggregation occ_h3. obis_h3t_url() base64-encodes SQL tile URL’s ?q=. consuming service MarineSensitivity/server/h3t (vendored h3t tile factory), rendered mapgl::add_h3t_source().

title: Serving OBIS indicators as H3 hexagon tiles (h3t)
text: obis_h3t_sql() generates validated SELECT. filter reads fast precomputed layer; taxon/years filter computes indicator live species store. obis_h3t_url() base64-encodes SQL ?q= tile URL (safely percent-encodes , +// base64 survive query parsing): Inspect value distribution (color-ramp breaks) stats endpoint:
code: library(obisindicators)  # default ES50 (all taxa) — precomputed, fast obis_h3t_sql("es") #> [1] "SELECT cell_id, es AS value, n FROM idx_h3 WHERE res = LEAST({{res}}, 7)"  # species richness for seabirds since 2000 — computed on the fly cat(obis_h3t_sql("sp", taxon = list(class = "Aves"), years = c(2000, NA))) #> WITH src AS ( #>   SELECT CAST(h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, LEAST({{res}}, 7)) AS BIGINT) AS cell_id, #>          species, SUM(records) AS ni #>   FROM occ_h3 #>   WHERE res = CASE WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 3 THEN 3 WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 5 THEN 5 ELSE 7 END #>     AND "class" = 'Aves' #>         AND date_year >= 2000 #>   GROUP BY 1, 2) #> SELECT cell_id, COUNT(*) AS value, SUM(ni) AS n FROM src GROUP BY cell_id obis_h3t_url(   base_url  = "h3tiles://h3tcache.marinesensitivity.org/h3t/{z}/{x}/{y}.h3t",   indicator = "es",   release   = "v20260623") #> [1] "h3tiles://h3tcache.marinesensitivity.org/h3t/{z}/{x}/{y}.h3t?q=U0VMRUNUIGNlbGxfaWQsIGVzIEFTIHZhbHVlLCBuIEZST00gaWR4X2gzIFdIRVJFIHJlcyA9IExFQVNUKHt7cmVzfX0sIDcp&release=v20260623" u <- obis_h3t_url(   base_url  = "https://h3tcache.marinesensitivity.org/h3t/stats",   indicator = "es") jsonlite::fromJSON(u)  # {min, max, p02, p98, n}

title: Scaling OBIS observations across H3 resolutions
text: Take one taxon — Cetacea (AphiaID 2688) — summarize every stored resolution. resolution rises, cell count climbs roughly ×7 per step median records-per-cell falls: signal spreads thinner. store keeps species-level occ_h3 three tiers (3 / 5 / 7); query res 1–2 rolls tier 3, res 4 tier 5, res 6 tier 7 (see obis_h3t_sql()). Rolling cheap; expense base-tier scan.
code: res_summary <- function(res) {   sql <- obis_h3t_sql("n", aphiaid = 2688, res_placeholder = as.character(res))   d <- dbGetQuery(con, sql)   tibble(res = res, n_cells = nrow(d),          records = sum(d$value), median_per_cell = median(d$value)) } purrr::map_dfr(1:7, res_summary) #> # res 1: few big cells, high density ... res 7: many cells, sparse

title: Scaling OBIS observations across H3 resolutions
text: Unfiltered coarse-rank (phylum/class/order) indicators precomputed idx_h3 / idx_h3_taxon (one row per cell, res 1–7) — served plain indexed lookup resolution. children-taxa (aphiaid=) SPUE paths precomputed layer: aggregate occ_h3 live, resolving WoRMS subtree recursive CTE request. Live cost grows () breadth subtree (class resolves tens thousands descendants) (b) base-tier row count fine resolution. server caps single statement H3T_STMT_TIMEOUT_MS (8 s); broad taxon res 7 can approach .
code: bench <- function(label, sql) {   t <- system.time(dbGetQuery(con, sql))[["elapsed"]]   tibble(query = label, seconds = round(t, 3)) } bind_rows(   bench("idx_h3 (precomputed, res 7)", obis_h3t_sql("es", res_placeholder = "7")),   bench("aphiaid Cetacea (live, res 7)",         obis_h3t_sql("n", aphiaid = 2688, res_placeholder = "7")),   bench("aphiaid diatoms (live, res 7)",   # ~71k descendant taxa         obis_h3t_sql("n", aphiaid = 148899, res_placeholder = "7")))

title: Scaling OBIS observations across H3 resolutions
text: effort proxy divides denominator (effort-taxon records per cell). denominator thins resolution faster intuition suggests: ratio 1/1 30/60 render, latter trustworthy. Track fraction cells whose effort n falls reliability floor:
code: floor_n <- 20 sparsity <- function(res) {   sql <- obis_spue_sql(num_aphiaid = 137111, den_aphiaid = 2688,  # dolphin / Cetacea                        res_placeholder = as.character(res))   d <- dbGetQuery(con, sql)   tibble(res = res, n_cells = nrow(d),          pct_below_floor = mean(d$n < floor_n)) } purrr::map_dfr(c(2, 4, 6, 7), sparsity) #> pct_below_floor rises steeply with res — fine-res SPUE is mostly low-effort noise

title: Scaling OBIS observations across H3 resolutions
text: Prefer precomputed layer filter knowable ahead time. -taxa phylum/class/order maps hit idx_h3 / idx_h3_taxon resolution-independent cost. children-taxa filter used heavily (e.g. fixed set EOV groups), precompute way. Cap res_max live paths. Serving broad subtree res 7 worst case; obis_h3t_sql(res_max = 5) keeps hexagons coarser (scan cheaper) high zoom. Consider descendant-closure table (ancestor_aphiaid → descendant_aphiaid) baked beside taxon, turning per-request recursive walk join — natural next step live children maps become hot. Read SPUE n. Style map value gate trust effort n; fine resolution cells low-effort. Aggregating coarser resolution (larger effort taxon) restores usable denominator.

what: Resolve the children of a taxon
title: Children taxa & an effort proxy (SPUE) from the OBIS snapshot
text: obis_taxon_children() returns seed taxon plus every descendant, rank, via recursive walk parentNameUsageID. full WoRMS table (~1.5 M rows) resolves fraction second. descendant AphiaIDs (cet$taxonID) exactly set used filter occ_h3.aphiaid. obis_taxon_subtree_sql() returns resolution standalone read-SELECT, handy API.
code: # Infraorder Cetacea = AphiaID 2688 (a rank that is NOT an occ_h3 column) cet <- obis_taxon_children(2688, con) nrow(cet)                              # ~1,665 descendant taxa table(cet$taxonRank)                   # Species, Genus, Family, ...  # Matt Biddle's phytoplankton example: class Bacillariophyceae (diatoms) = 148899 dia <- obis_taxon_children(148899, con) nrow(dia)                              # ~71,500 descendant taxa

title: Children taxa & an effort proxy (SPUE) from the OBIS snapshot
text: obis_h3t_sql(aphiaid = ...) builds served tile query filters occ_h3 subtree via recursive CTE (h3t validator permits RECURSIVE). obis_h3t_url() base64-encodes tile URL.
code: sql <- obis_h3t_sql(indicator = "n", aphiaid = 2688)   # # records, all Cetacea cat(sql) #> WITH RECURSIVE taxon_tree AS ( #> SELECT taxonID, parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon #> WHERE taxonID IN (2688) #> UNION ALL #> SELECT t.taxonID, t.parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon t #> JOIN taxon_tree tt ON t.parentNameUsageID = tt.taxonID #> WHERE t.parentNameUsageID IS NOT NULL), src AS ( #>   SELECT CAST(h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, LEAST({{res}}, 7)) AS BIGINT) AS cell_id, #>          species, SUM(records) AS ni #>   FROM occ_h3 #>   WHERE res = CASE WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 3 THEN 3 WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 5 THEN 5 ELSE 7 END #>     AND aphiaid IN (SELECT taxonID FROM taxon_tree) #>   GROUP BY 1, 2) #> SELECT cell_id, SUM(ni) AS value, SUM(ni) AS n FROM src GROUP BY cell_id  url <- obis_h3t_url(   base_url  = "h3tiles://h3t.marinesensitivity.org/h3t/{z}/{x}/{y}.h3t",   sql       = sql) library(mapgl) maplibre(center = c(-40, 20), zoom = 1.5) |>   add_h3t_source(id = "cet", tiles = url) |>   add_fill_layer(     id = "cet_fill", source = "cet", source_layer = "cet",     fill_color = interpolate(       column = "value", values = c(1, 1000),       stops  = c("#3b528b", "#5ec962")))

what: An effort proxy: sightings per unit effort (SPUE)
title: Children taxa & an effort proxy (SPUE) from the OBIS snapshot
text: raw record map conflates abundance observation effort — hexagon lights species common people looked hard. records come multi-species surveys, higher-order taxon gives presence-proxy effort: within footprint , say, Cetacea (surveys recorded whale/dolphin), fraction records target species? SPUEcell=records target taxonrecords effort taxon\text{SPUE}_{cell} = \frac{\text{records target taxon}}{\text{records effort taxon}} obis_spue_sql() builds served tile query (two recursive subtrees: numerator = target, denominator = effort). calc_spue() pinned R reference (see test-spue-parity.R). tooltip n carries effort count (denominator): bright cell backed large n robust SPUE; bright cell n = 3 noise. Choosing effort taxon analyst’s call — parent class order sensible default, survey-defined group (e.g. Cetacea, seabirds) often better. See vignette("scaling") denominator’s sparsity behaves across H3 resolutions.
code: # target: Tursiops truncatus (common bottlenose dolphin) = 137111 # effort: Infraorder Cetacea = 2688 (its multi-species-survey footprint) spue_sql <- obis_spue_sql(num_aphiaid = 137111, den_aphiaid = 2688) cat(spue_sql) #> WITH RECURSIVE num_tree AS ( #> SELECT taxonID, parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon #> WHERE taxonID IN (137111) #> UNION ALL #> SELECT t.taxonID, t.parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon t #> JOIN num_tree tt ON t.parentNameUsageID = tt.taxonID #> WHERE t.parentNameUsageID IS NOT NULL), #> den_tree AS ( #> SELECT taxonID, parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon #> WHERE taxonID IN (2688) #> UNION ALL #> SELECT t.taxonID, t.parentNameUsageID #> FROM taxon t #> JOIN den_tree tt ON t.parentNameUsageID = tt.taxonID #> WHERE t.parentNameUsageID IS NOT NULL), #> src AS ( #>   SELECT CAST(h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, LEAST({{res}}, 7)) AS BIGINT) AS cell_id, #>          -- COALESCE so an effort cell lacking the target reads 0, not NULL #>          -- (matches calc_spue(): sum of no records is 0). presence-only: #>          -- the target was absent *despite* effort here. #>          COALESCE(SUM(records) FILTER (WHERE aphiaid IN (SELECT taxonID FROM num_tree)), 0) AS n_num, #>          SUM(records) AS n_den #>   FROM occ_h3 #>   WHERE res = CASE WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 3 THEN 3 WHEN LEAST({{res}}, 7) <= 5 THEN 5 ELSE 7 END #>     AND aphiaid IN (SELECT taxonID FROM den_tree) #>   GROUP BY 1) #> SELECT cell_id, #>        n_num::DOUBLE / NULLIF(n_den, 0) AS value, #>        n_den AS n #> FROM src  spue_url <- obis_h3t_url(   base_url = "h3tiles://h3t.marinesensitivity.org/h3t/{z}/{x}/{y}.h3t",   sql      = spue_sql) maplibre(center = c(-40, 20), zoom = 1.5) |>   add_h3t_source(id = "spue", tiles = spue_url) |>   add_fill_layer(     id = "spue_fill", source = "spue", source_layer = "spue",     fill_color = interpolate(       column = "value", values = c(0, 1),       stops  = c("#440154", "#fde725"))) dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

title: Build the OBIS H3 DuckDB store — build_obis_h3_duckdb
text: src occurrence source. Either data.frame occurrences, character vector parquet path(s)/glob(s) readable DuckDB (e.g. "s3://obis-open-data/occurrence/*.parquet"). Must expose columns decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude, species (optionally) aphiaid, phylum, class, order, family, genus, date_year, records, dropped, absence. Missing taxonomic columns filled NULL. path_duckdb output DuckDB file path. region_bbox optional c(lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max) restrict region (recommended first/demo build). esn expected sample size ES(n); default 50 (matches ES50). s3_region AWS region s3:// sources (default "us-east-1"). s3_anonymous use anonymous S3 access public buckets (default TRUE). memory_limit optional DuckDB memory_limit (e.g. "10GB"). Strongly recommended src parquet/S3 glob: global OBIS scan otherwise exhaust RAM can wedge host. Leave GB headroom physical RAM. threads optional DuckDB thread cap (e.g. 2L) bound CPU/RAM. temp_dir optional directory DuckDB spill disk exceeds memory_limit. Needs ample free space (global build can spill many GB); point roomy volume, /tmp. max_temp_dir_size optional cap DuckDB disk spill (e.g. "20GB"). Prevents runaway aggregation filling volume crashing host. Set comfortably available free disk. overwrite overwrite existing path_duckdb (default TRUE).

title: Calculate Biodiversity Indicators, including ES50 (Hurlbert index) — calc_indicators
text: expected number marine species random sample 50 individuals (records) indicator marine biodiversity richness. ES50 defined OBIS sum(esi) species following per species calculation: `n - ni >= 50 (n total number records cell ni total number records ith-species) esi = 1 - exp(lngamma(n-ni+1) + lngamma(n-50+1) - lngamma(n-ni-50+1) - lngamma(n+1)) n >= 50 - esi = 1 else - esi = NULL Warning: ES50 assumes individuals randomly distributed, sample size sufficiently large, samples taxonomically similar, samples taken manner.

title: Build an h3t tile SQL query for an OBIS biodiversity indicator — obis_h3t_sql
text: indicator one "es" (ES50), "sp" (richness), "shannon", "n" (# records). taxon optional named list/vector restricting taxa, names among phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, e.g. list(class = "Aves") list(phylum = c("Mollusca", "Cnidaria")). aphiaid optional integer WoRMS AphiaID(s). Filters occ_h3 every descendant taxon ids (rank), resolved baked taxon table. Takes precedence taxon; combines years. years optional c(min, max) year range (either may NA). esn expected sample size ES(n); default 50. res_max cap H3 resolution (1-7). Lower = coarser/bigger hexagons given map zoom ("base zoom level" control); store's finest resolution 7. Default 7 (track zoom finest). res_placeholder resolution placeholder; default "{{res}}". h3t tile server prunes tile automatically: derives tile's covering coarse H3 cells z/x/y injects hex_prune (...) idx_h3 / occ_h3 scan (see build_obis_h3_duckdb() H3T_PRUNE_RES), emitted SQL plain per-resolution SELECT — client-side bbox.

title: Build an h3t tile SQL query for an OBIS biodiversity indicator — obis_h3t_sql
text: Query routing (fastest first): taxon/aphiaid/years filter → precomputed -taxa idx_h3 layer. single value one precomputed rank (phylum/class/order) years → precomputed idx_h3_taxon layer (just fast). aphiaid filter → live indicator occ_h3, filtered AphiaID subtree resolved baked taxon table via recursive CTE (arbitrary rank, e.g. Infraorder Cetacea); see obis_taxon_children(). anything else (finer rank, multiple values, year range) → live indicator computed fly species-level occ_h3 store, selecting resolution tier matches tile zoom.

title: obisindicators 0.4.1
text: vignette("h3") runs full h3-grid → calc_indicators() → gmap_indicator() pipeline shipped occ_1M renders ES(50) map (deckgl install/demo stays code-). vignette("taxon_children") now renders generated RECURSIVE tile SQL tile URLs obis_h3t_sql(aphiaid=) / obis_spue_sql() (pure builders, store needed); DB-connection mapgl widget chunks stay code-. vignette("h3t") suppresses package-load messages evaluated obis_h3t_sql() output clean. Chunks genuinely require deployed S3 / DuckDB store / h3t tile service (vignette("scaling"), build/deploy/map chunks) remain illustrative code, run CI.

title: obisindicators 0.4.0
text: build_obis_h3_duckdb() now materializes coarse H3-parent column hex_prune = h3_cell_to_parent(cell_id, LEAST(res, H3T_PRUNE_RES)) (res 3) occ_h3 idx_h3 clusters (res, hex_prune, cell_id). replaces interim lat/lng clustering — pruning H3 index 2D (tighter latitude band), needs extra float columns, covering ids canonical H3 (match across R build server version drift). Store schema change — rebuild, migrate data-raw/migrate_add_spatial_cluster.R (drops lat/lng, adds hex_prune). obis_h3t_sql() / obis_spue_sql() now emit plain per-resolution SELECTs — bbox_placeholder argument removed. server (MarineSensitivity/server/h3t, CalCOFI/api-h3t-py) rewrites query add hex_prune (<covering cells>) scan table carrying column; stores without untouched. math unchanged still pinned calc_indicators() / calc_spue(); test-h3t-prune.R asserts prune result-preserving (hex_prune-pruned scan + server’s outer centroid filter returns exactly cells values unpruned scan).

title: obisindicators 0.3.0
text: build_obis_h3_duckdb() materialized cell-centroid lat/lng columns occ_h3 idx_h3 clustered (res, lat, lng). obis_h3t_sql() / obis_spue_sql() gained bbox_placeholder argument (default "{{bbox}}") h3t service substituted per tile lat/lng predicate. math stayed pinned calc_indicators() / calc_spue(); prune asserted result-preserving.

title: obisindicators 0.2.0
text: obis_taxon_children() / obis_taxon_subtree_sql() recursively walk taxon table (baked store; data-raw/build_taxon_parquet.R + data-raw/migrate_add_taxon.R) return every descendant taxon. obis_h3t_sql(aphiaid=) serves arbitrary-rank children maps filtering occ_h3.aphiaid resolved subtree via RECURSIVE CTE. calc_spue() (R reference) + obis_spue_sql() compute presence-effort proxy records(target subtree) / records(effort subtree) per cell, pinned test-spue-parity.R. build_obis_h3_duckdb() builds authoritative DuckDB store OBIS open-data parquet — precomputed -taxa indicator layer (idx_h3, res 1–7) plus species-level store (occ_h3, tiers 3/5/7) --fly taxon/year-filtered queries. ES50/Shannon/Simpson/richness math SQL translation calc_indicators(), pinned new parity test. obis_h3t_sql() / obis_h3t_url() compose validated read-SELECT base64-encoded tile URL h3t service (MarineSensitivity/server/h3t) mapgl::add_h3t_source(). canonical SQL inst/sql/; server build driver data-raw/build_obis_h3_duckdb.R.
